<objective>
Portable Confluence Cloud publishing mechanics — the attachment-upload recipe, ADF media forms, page-tree ops, the draft/publish race, render verification, and deterministic stills. Ships zero company-specific content; reads org pointers from the shared company-knowledge config contract.

Phases:

- preflight: Confirm a logged-in browser tab on the Atlassian origin, resolve the target page id, and confirm you are operating on a DRAFT
- upload-attachments: Upload attachments via the scratch-file + osascript injection recipe (the Atlassian MCP has no attachment API); verify authoritatively with a GET
- emit-adf: Always emit media-single figures; document media-inline file-chips; never rely on media-group for figures
- page-tree-ops: Create children under a draft parent, order the sidebar via the move endpoint, and preserve data-local-id on retained nodes in full-body round-trips
- handle-draft-publish-race: Understand draft-vs-just-published update semantics, stale-editor clobbering, and tiny-link resolution timing
- verify-render: Run DOM render assertions in view or editor mode before declaring a page done
- deterministic-stills: Render reproducible stills with a browser automation tool against local file HTML with fixed color scheme and reduced motion
  </objective>
